## 5. Memory and data movement {#memory}

Start with the payload path between global memory, LDS, and VGPRs, then check whether the named instruction or builtin is available for your target. RDNA 4 transpose loads place data in VGPRs; global-to-LDS builtins have their own target conditions. The later tables cover cache controls, addressing, and atomics as separate choices.

:::: {.note}

**RDNA 4 transpose-load ISA behavior:** Global-memory loads transpose data into VGPRs. The ISA defines `GLOBAL_LOAD_TR_B128` and `GLOBAL_LOAD_TR_B64`. [ISA pp.152–153](https://gpuopen.com/download/rdna4-instruction-set-architecture.pdf#page=152 "ISA §11.6, pp.152–153").

::::

:::: {.note #global-lds-builtin-scope}

The availability row reports AMD’s builtin table, not a prohibition on every possible hardware memory-to-LDS path. It refers specifically to `__builtin_amdgcn_global_load_lds`, `__builtin_amdgcn_load_to_lds`, `__builtin_amdgcn_raw_ptr_buffer_load_lds`, and `__builtin_amdgcn_struct_ptr_buffer_load_lds`. Clang lists `vmem-to-lds-load-insts` as their required target feature. [Global](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUBuiltinReference.html#builtin-amdgcn-global-load-lds) · [Generic](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUBuiltinReference.html#builtin-amdgcn-load-to-lds) · [Raw buffer](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUBuiltinReference.html#builtin-amdgcn-raw-ptr-buffer-load-lds) · [Structured buffer](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUBuiltinReference.html#builtin-amdgcn-struct-ptr-buffer-load-lds).

::::

:::: {.note}

**RDNA 4 deferred atomic scope:** `TH[2]` controls deferred scope for non-returning cascading atomics. Their full scope is realized at a subsequent release of matching or higher scope. [ISA p.51](https://gpuopen.com/download/rdna4-instruction-set-architecture.pdf#page=51).

::::

### Instruction and platform scope

```{=html}
<ul>
<li><strong>Transpose EXEC semantics:</strong> EXEC=0 makes the transpose-load instructions no-ops; any other EXEC value must have all bits set, otherwise behavior is undefined. <a href="https://gpuopen.com/download/rdna4-instruction-set-architecture.pdf#page=152">ISA §11.6.2</a>.</li>
<li><strong>LDS direct load:</strong> <code>DS_DIRECT_LOAD</code> reads LDS into VGPRs and is restricted to CU mode. <a href="https://gpuopen.com/download/rdna4-instruction-set-architecture.pdf#page=160">ISA §12.4</a>.</li>
<li><strong>RDNA 3.5 APUs:</strong> AMD’s system guide describes per-process GPUVM address spaces for Ryzen APUs with <code>gfx1150</code>, <code>gfx1151</code>, and <code>gfx1152</code>. <a href="https://rocm.docs.amd.com/en/docs-10.1.0/reference/system-optimization/rdna3-5.html#memory-settings">ROCm 10.1 memory settings</a>.</li>
</ul>
```
